The '''Northern Sea''' was located on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. It was here that [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] murdered his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
